scope: Fresno-relevant NWS Hanford briefing context in Area Watch, without map, attention-rule, private-storage or permission changes.

sources.method: Read source text and visually inspect original page previews. Paraphrases, source probabilities and confidence remain separate from app planning questions. This is not county approval of resource assignments.

newCases: Exact source revision and page identity
Changed or missing public revision withholds its previous summaries
Dated partner context is independently labeled
Failed and overdue source checks qualify retained evidence
Pacific calendar forecast windows become past-period context without download renewal
Invalid dates, pages, duplicate IDs and alternate URLs fail validation
Confidence categories are not inferred from probabilities

verifiedLocally: Compact Calcite area headings expose impact, timing and confidence
Expanded cards include source probabilities, scope and responsible-team review prompts
Snow citation opens verified public PDF at page 2 of 4
Foothill citation opens verified partner slides at page 2 of 19
Cards and review prompts wrap at 390x844 without horizontal overflow
Existing area-review and power counts remain independent of briefing reads
browser.publishedProof: Save deployment result and screenshots under ignored work/qa-0.21.0 after Pages completes.

limits: Fresno applicability is a regional text interpretation; no new impact geometry or site-specific probabilities
Kern-only wind and heavy rain are excluded; Tioga Pass is explicitly outside Fresno
Source-specific confidence and probabilities are not blended across documents
A new public PDF requires a maintainer to read and update its summary register before summaries resume
The October 19 partner deck is a dated archive, not a live feed
No automatic dispatch, flood prediction, team acknowledgement or county activation
rollback: Redeploy ccce131337edc76698e42f71eec334f17416b5f5 (0.20.0); no data migration or AGOL changes.
